notes: imd/place (https://x.com/imdplace), for Robinhood Chain 4663. Based on accepted job 834c0e87-f40c-4a5d-9935-03d865b034ec and bundle 624e4be3dda1c33c6258619a53a63170bebcefca7c0890da5dcd5fa2a34cfac0, retaining subsequent contributor repairs. PlaceToken is the launch ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. PlaceHook takes PoolManager, launch token and launch factory in that order; its five declared permissions encode flags 8396 (0x20cc). All enabled callbacks require PoolManager. beforeInitialize binds one pool and requires the supplied factory and LP fee 12500. The pool uses the requested IMD address, fee 12500 (1.25%), tick spacing 60 and initialPrice 79228162514264337593543950336 as decimal sqrtPriceX96, matching the supplied launch #1015 settings. PlaceHook's constructor deploys Canvas and PlaceRouter; Canvas deploys Seasons, the ERC-721 and auction contract. Discover their addresses through hook.canvas(), hook.router() and canvas.seasons(). These contracts have no owner, admin, upgrade or pause. Buys credit nontransferable, nonexpiring paint at one drop per 0.05 IMD of gross input; hookData is accepted only from PlaceRouter, otherwise an empty hookData uses tx.origin. Sells neither credit nor consume paint. Canvas stores a 64x64 grid with 16 colours and one packed slot per pixel per season. Painting accepts up to 50 distinct pixels, consumes drops and doubles each pixel's cost within its 24-hour window, capped at 1024 drops; empty pixels and expired windows cost one. The hook charges IMD on buys and sells in addition to the LP fee, decaying linearly from 35% to 2% over the first 30 minutes. The base 2% splits 67% to current pixel owners, 25% to the season pot and 8% to 0xA7e99BB7155D7477E0C838E201b16E62B9c0b5Ac; rounding and the launch surcharge go to the pot. With no owned pixels, the artist share also goes to the pot. Fees accrue as PoolManager ERC-6909 claims, redeemed through authenticated unlocks for earned payouts. The per-pixel accumulator settles ownership changes and preserves former owners' claimable earnings. After seven days, permissionless endSeason freezes the canvas, mints its on-chain SVG NFT and starts a fresh canvas; an earlier unbid auction must be finalized before the next freeze. Seasons runs 24-hour IMD auctions with 5% minimum raises rounded up, ten-minute deadline extensions for late bids and immediately withdrawable pull refunds. Winning bid plus frozen pot is claimable by final pixel owners, with rank-based rounding distributing the full amount. Without bids the NFT goes to the top painter and the pot rolls forward; a blank season's NFT remains in escrow. Metadata includes the season name, social URL, season, painters and paints. The existing responsive site/ implements canvas zoom/pan, palette and pixel details, batch painting, router buys, holdings and earnings claims, leaderboard, timers, auctions/refunds, NFT gallery, payout totals and social/explorer links. Production deployment and hosting remain launch-service steps: resolve the placeholders, deploy and initialize the pool, verify child addresses with tools/configure-site.mjs, then publish site/ against those live addresses. This manifest describes the implementation; deployment policy is supplied separately.
